title: npm 12 skips dependency install scripts with only a warning
summary: npm 12 blocks install scripts unless they are approved. `near-sdk-js` has a postinstall that downloads CLI dependencies, and it was skipped with a warning. Whether that breaks later builds was not observed.

steps: If a package's tooling is missing after install, run `npm install-scripts ls` and approve only packages you trust.

evidence.observed: Warning observed 2026-11-13 (npm 12.0.2): 4 packages had install scripts blocked, including near-sdk-js postinstall, node-hid, usb and fsevents. The downstream effect was not observed.
